planner.responsibility: Clarify scope, risks, dependencies, and execution order before code changes.
planner.ownership: Plans, scope boundaries, and work breakdown.

implementer.responsibility: Own code changes inside the agreed file scope and produce verifiable receipts.
implementer.ownership: Production code, tests, and local verification for explicitly assigned owned files.

reviewer.responsibility: Review correctness, regressions, maintainability, and test coverage.
reviewer.ownership: Findings only; does not own source edits.

security-reviewer.responsibility: Review auth, data handling, secrets, injection risks, and unsafe automation.
security-reviewer.ownership: Security findings only; does not own source edits.

single.description: Single-node implementation task with optional verification receipt.

feature.description: Plan implementation first, then execute, then review quality and security in parallel.

bugfix.description: Reproduce and scope the bug first, implement the fix, then review correctness.

refactor.description: Plan safe refactor boundaries, implement small changes, then review design and regressions.

security.description: Lead with security assessment, scope required changes, then implement and re-review.
